$comment: Written reasons for the capabilities catalogue (docs/DSL_CAPABILITIES.html), batch 3 of N, 2026-11-22 (REG-357, owner: do only 20% of the remaining cases, of mixed complexity). One reason per keyword: what need it serves and why a lower rung of the extension ladder (expression, function, flow step, hand-written code) or an existing keyword cannot do it. The reasons state the need, not the evidence counts: the catalogue's own columns show samples, tests and examples and change as the corpus grows, so a count written here would go stale. The batch is every 5th keyword still without a reason, taken within each kind of value (boolean, text, number, choice, list, object, reference) so simple and complex ones are mixed. Key = slot id exactly as the catalogue shows it; the generator refuses a reason for a keyword the schema does not have.

reasons.agentAccessChannel.enabled: A chat channel that starts answering the moment it is declared would open the app to anyone who finds the bot; an explicit switch, off by default, makes going live a deliberate choice, and no flow or expression can stand in because the channel is platform plumbing.
reasons.enumOption.deprecated: An old shipping method must stop being offered without breaking the rows that already carry it; a flag on the option keeps old data valid and hides the choice for new data, where deleting the option would orphan history.
reasons.guidePage.default: When someone opens the guide without naming a page, one page has to come first; marking it as the default avoids a rule such as 'the first in the list', which would silently change when pages are reordered.
reasons.lifecycleState.terminal: A delivered order must not be reopened by accident; marking a state as final lets the validator refuse any exit from it and lets the screens lock the row, instead of every flow remembering the rule.
reasons.presentationMetadata.showInDefaultWebUi: Some boxes are for the API or for flows only, such as an internal key; one switch keeps them off the generated screens while they stay in the API, so no custom screen is needed just to leave a box out.
reasons.actionMetadata.dangerLevel: Deleting an account and refreshing a list should not feel alike; a four-step scale lets the screen add the right amount of confirmation styling, where a single yes-or-no 'dangerous' flag could not tell caution from alarm.
reasons.conversionSplitTarget.take: Splitting 'Maria Silva' into first and last name has to say which half goes where; a two-value choice covers the split-at-the-first-space case in one declaration, and anything subtler is the job of a hand-written conversion.
reasons.field.duplicationPolicy: A list of tags may repeat a value but a list of invitees must not; stating it on the array field refuses repeats the same way for every writer, where an expression would have to be repeated in every flow that fills the list.
reasons.flowStep.ifExists: An import that creates the same country twice should not fail on its second run; 'skip' turns a clash on the unique fields into a quiet no-op with a null output, which would otherwise take a query step and a condition around every create.
reasons.pack:category: A store with hundreds of packs needs shelves to drill into; a closed list of categories keeps 'security' and 'Security' from becoming two shelves, which free text would allow.
reasons.panelWidget.aggregate: A tile that shows 'orders' and one that shows 'total revenue' differ only in how the rows are reduced; a five-value choice picks count, sum, average, minimum or maximum without a query written per tile.
reasons.root:dslVersion: The format of a model will change over time; a version stamp lets the tools say 'this model is from another era' instead of misreading it, and because it defaults to the current one almost no author has to write it.
reasons.workbenchActionApplyTo.mode: Folding a result into a draft could one day mean replace or merge; the mode is kept as a one-value choice only so another way can be added without renaming the keyword, and the general form is the action's after-action flow.
reasons.agentAccess.expose: An agent connected to the app must be told exactly which concepts, flows and aggregates it may touch; an explicit allow-list with at least one entry keeps 'expose everything' from being the default.
reasons.autoPanelSurface.actions: A generated workbench needs its buttons; a typed list, checked when the schema is read, catches a mistyped key that a free-form bag of metadata would swallow without a word.
reasons.concept.events: Saying 'when an order is created, announce it' next to the concept keeps the fact and its trigger together; a nested event with a mode is published by the generated create, update or delete, which a flow would have to publish by hand.
reasons.documentBand.fields: A document band with no boxes prints a blank block that looks like 'this record has no data'; requiring at least one binding turns the empty case into an error at validation instead of a puzzling page.
reasons.field.enumValues: A 'status' box that accepts any text invites typos; a closed list of values drives the dropdown, the filter and the validation from one declaration, with option objects when a label, icon or colour is also needed.
reasons.flowStep.onTimeout: An approval nobody answers should escalate rather than hang forever; steps that run once the deadline passes let the flow notify a manager and carry on, where a bare timeout can only give up the wait.
reasons.lifecycle.states: A board of states needs labels and the initial and final marks; the list is optional because the states derive from the transitions, and it exists for the cases where a state needs more than its name.
reasons.pack:domainTypes: A pack that brings 'postal code' should bring its rules with it; contributing domain types lets every app that installs the pack reuse them instead of redeclaring them.
reasons.pack:properties: A pack's behaviour often depends on settings such as a leave limit; contributing the properties with the pack lets the operator change them through the same cascade, without the pack inventing a settings screen of its own.
reasons.panelAction.permissionRequirements: A 'Refund' button should appear only for people who may refund; listing the required permissions hides and guards the action from one place, where a check inside a flow would show the button and fail on the click.
reasons.query.aggregates: A report of 'revenue per city' needs totals, not rows; aggregate columns computed per group let the query do it in the database, where a flow summing rows would have to read every row first.
reasons.referenceDefinition.pickerColumns: When someone picks a customer from a dialog, a name alone is rarely enough to tell two of them apart; choosing the columns shown there saves declaring a picker screen for every reference.
reasons.root:events: Flows publish, trigger on and await named facts, so the facts need declared names and payloads; a model-level list is where they live when they belong to no single concept.
reasons.root:properties: An operator should be able to change a setting such as a tax rate without editing the model; declared properties resolved through the scope cascade are the one place for that, where a constant inside an expression would need a new release.
reasons.transactionUiState.values: A toggle such as 'show only open lines' offers a few fixed states; declaring the closed set lets the validator refuse a predicate that compares against a value the control can never take.
reasons.capabilityPolicy.bulkheadMaxConcurrent: One slow supplier should not use up every worker; capping simultaneous calls to a capability keeps a stalled integration from starving the rest, which a retry written in a flow cannot prevent.
reasons.enumOption.order: A dropdown is often not alphabetical, as in 'Low, Medium, High'; an order number places a member without rewriting the whole list, and members without one follow in declaration order.
reasons.field.scale: Money keeps two digits after the point and a rate four; the scale fixes how many a decimal box stores and shows, so rounding is decided once on the field and not again on every screen.
reasons.presentationMetadata.column: A form with twelve boxes reads better in two columns; putting a box in a numbered column gives a layout without a hand-made screen.
reasons.schemaObject.maxItems: A list of attachments or phone numbers should not grow without bound; a maximum on the array refuses oversize input at the door, where a limit written in a flow would have to be repeated at every entry point.
reasons.agentAccess.assistant: The built-in assistant answering in a chat needs a name, instructions, a language and a model profile; one object describes how it behaves, so an app does not have to build its own bot just to change a tone.
reasons.awaitMatch.payload: A flow waiting for 'order approved' must wake for its own order, not for any order; matching payload fields against expressions ties the event that arrives to the flow instance that waits.
reasons.field.picker: A reference box's pick dialog sometimes needs a filter or a multi-select; declaring it on the field uses the same shape a band's picker accepts, so one picker vocabulary serves both surfaces.
reasons.httpConnectorOperation.headers: An outside API may want one more header, such as a version; per-operation headers with {name} substitution cover it without a hand-written client for a single line.
reasons.pack:augments: A pack that adds a loyalty field to another pack's customer must change that concept without owning it; declaring that it augments, additively, lets two packs compose, where copying the concept would fork it.
reasons.panelAction.explainability: An action that moves money should say why it exists, for an AI agent deciding whether to call it and for an auditor reading the trail; a free-form object carries that without a new keyword per explanation.
reasons.root:metadata: Authors sometimes need to leave a note on the model, such as an owner or a ticket reference; a free-form object that never carries behaviour gives them the place without a new keyword each time.
reasons.actionMetadata.label: A button must say 'Approve', not a technical name, and in each language the app speaks; a localizable caption is the one place that text lives.
reasons.autoPanelSurface.hooks: A workbench sometimes needs a check before an action or a calculation on load; a hooks object attaches flows around the transaction without writing a whole screen by hand.
reasons.capabilityOperationError.classification: A payment refused by the bank must not be retried but a timeout may be; classifying each error as transient, permanent or a contract violation tells the retry policy what to do, which a message string cannot.
reasons.domainType.validation: Every 'postal code' box should enforce the same length and pattern; hanging one schema on the type applies it to every field of that type, where repeating it per field would drift.
reasons.flow.inputSchema: A flow called from a button, an API or an agent should refuse malformed input at the door; a schema on the flow describes the input once for all callers instead of a check at the top of each flow.
reasons.guidePageRegions.right: A guide page has a left, a centre and a right area; settings for the right one let a page choose what sits there without a template per page.
reasons.presentationMetadata.label: People should read 'Delivery date', not 'deliveryDate', in their own language; a label per box, plain or per locale, defaults to a prettified name so most authors write none.
reasons.transactionUiState.label: A control that switches a screen's state must say what it does; its caption is the one text a person reads on it.
reasons.actionMetadata.confirmationText: Before an irreversible click the person should be asked a real question such as 'Cancel this order?'; the text is that question, where a generic 'Are you sure?' would not say what is at stake.
reasons.aggregateBalance.discriminatorField: A balance such as 'debits equal credits' sums two sides of the same rows; naming the box that tells the sides apart lets the platform check the rule without the author writing the grouping.
reasons.aggregateCollection.name: A tree of an order and its lines needs each child collection addressed; the name is that address, and a nested collection is addressed through its parent, so a path inside a draft is never ambiguous.
reasons.aggregateInvariant.expression: A rule across a whole order, such as 'no line has a zero quantity and the lines do not exceed the total', cannot be checked one row at a time; an expression over the draft tree, run before the commit, is the smallest form that sees everything.
reasons.capability.type: Tools and packs sometimes need to find 'every payment connector'; a free-form kind label groups capabilities without a closed list that every new kind of integration would have to extend.
reasons.cellGrid.colField: A seating plan or a shelf layout is a grid whose cells are stored as rows; naming the integer box that holds the column tells the grid where each row sits.
reasons.concept.satelliteOf: A pack that adds boxes to another pack's user must not edit that pack; a satellite concept links to its base by a unique, required reference, so the base stays untouched and can be upgraded on its own.
reasons.conversion.else: A case conversion with no matching clause would otherwise leave the value empty; an 'else' literal gives the default in the same declaration, and leaving it out stays allowed for when empty is right.
reasons.conversionLookupMatch.concept: Converting old codes through a lookup table has to know which concept holds the table; naming it is the one input without which a lookup cannot match anything.
reasons.domainType.format: A phone number has a mask and a tax id a known format; a hint on the type shows users and AI authors the expected shape without repeating a pattern on every field.
reasons.event.specializes: An app's 'OrderPlaced' may refine a pack's generic event; naming the base records that relationship instead of copying the event under a new name.
reasons.field.domainType: A box that is a 'postal code' should inherit its base type, validation, normalization and presentation; naming the domain type brings all of that in one word, where repeating them per field would drift apart.
reasons.flow.name: Everything that calls a flow, whether the API, a button, an agent or another flow, needs one stable name for it; the name is that address and is unique in the model.
reasons.flowStep.capability: A flow that charges a card or sends a message calls a declared capability by name; the name keeps the flow free of vendor details, which live in the connector.
reasons.flowStep.from: A step that copies a value or publishes an event needs a source; a reference to the flow's own state names where it comes from, so no extra step is needed just to assemble a payload.
reasons.flowStep.scope: A step that checks or creates rows has to say which concept it acts on; the scope names it, and the validator checks that it exists.
reasons.guidePageGadget.url: A guide page sometimes shows a fixed piece of HTML such as a help text; a same-origin path is fetched and inserted without running scripts, which keeps the page safe where an arbitrary address would not.
reasons.httpConnector.baseUrl: A connector to an outside API needs its root address; an absolute http or https address, or a property that supplies it, keeps each operation's own path short.
reasons.humanTask.outcomeField: When a person chooses Approve or Reject on a task, the choice has to land where the flow can read it; naming the payload key lets the flow branch on it, with 'outcome' as the default.
reasons.invariant.expr: 'End date is after start date' must hold however the row is written; a boolean expression over the row's own boxes, checked on every write, is the smallest rule that stops bad data in every screen and every API.
reasons.localModelRef.$ref: A large model is easier to keep as many files; a relative path to the file that holds an item lets the model be split without any new vocabulary.
reasons.pack:pack: Every definition a pack brings is prefixed with the pack's name so that two packs never collide; the identifier is that namespace, lowercase and without spaces so it is safe inside names and addresses.
reasons.panelAction.dataSource: A button that works on a row must know which list the row belongs to when a panel shows several; naming the data source ties the action to the right rows.
reasons.panelDataSource.concept: A panel's list reads the rows of a concept; naming the concept gives the generated query, columns and permissions in one word.
reasons.panelFieldBinding.enabledWhen: A box should be editable only in some situations, such as a price while the order is still open; an expression keeps the rule next to the box, where a flow could only react after a rejected save.
reasons.panelWidget.field: A sum tile has to know which number to add; naming the numeric box is the input that sum, average, minimum and maximum all need.
reasons.presentationMetadata.description: A box such as 'Credit limit' may need one sentence of help; the description is shown next to the control, so the form explains itself without a separate manual.
reasons.presentationMetadata.section: A long form reads better as titled blocks; naming a section groups boxes without a hand-made layout.
reasons.query.concept: A query reads the rows of one concept; the name is the starting point from which columns, filters and permissions follow.
reasons.queryLookup.name: A query that pulls the customer's name into an order row needs the new column to be called something; the name is the column the lookup result is bound as.
reasons.referenceDefinition.displayField: A reference to a customer should show 'Maria Silva', not an identifier; naming the display box gives every dropdown and list the readable text.
reasons.root:version: A model needs its own version so that one change can be told from the one before; it is required, as a plain string such as 1.0.0.
reasons.seed.concept: Sample rows must say which concept they fill; inside a pack the name must be one that same pack declares, and it is rewritten to its pack-qualified form when the pack is composed.
reasons.workbenchBandPicker.selectorRef: Two panels that need the same picker should not copy its columns and filters; pointing at a picker screen adopts it wholesale, and the band's own filter is combined with it.
